note: What a Codex turn may contain at each level. The item type names are the ones recorded in recorded/ (agent_message, command_execution, web_search, error); reasoning and todo_list are not in any recording, so they are listed as unverified. A level's items are the only item types a turn may carry: an item.started or item.completed of any other type (except a note, below) stops the turn with nm_level_exceeded. `offered` says which levels NotchMeow offers (owner rulings, 2026-10-28: Chat only, and quick actions as level none; read is not offered (R1), agent is not offered (R4) and is absent here). `shellOff` says the level's argv carries the shell-off set (SHELL_OFF in reference.py; FINDINGS step 13). A read level is kept as not offered so its parse cases still fail closed.

thread.started.source: owner-named edge case of the order-free thread id rule (2026-10-29): a thread.started with two keys besides type, never recorded
